author: The Current
description:
Grammy-winning producer Jimmy Jam talks about A Celebration of the Minneapolis Sound happening at the Minnesota State Fair
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

On Saturday, Aug. 29, at the Minnesota State Fair Grandstand, Minneapolis-raised, Grammy-winning and hitmaking producers Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis are putting on a show called Jimmy Jam & Terry Lewis Homecoming: A Celebration of the Minneapolis Sound. During a recent visit on MPR News with Angela Davis, Jimmy Jam talks about the mindset he and Terry Lewis are bringing to the Grandstand. "It's a celebration of the people," Jam says.

Find the full conversation here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zlDucbxPL7k

author: The Current
description:
Watch Medium Build play three songs and chat with host Jill Riley
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Medium Build — aka Nick Carpenter — grew up in Georgia and went to college at Middle Tennessee State University near Nashville. Carpenter studied songwriting at MTSU, a venerable music institution that counts among its alumni artists including Alicia Bognanno of Bully, Sharon Van Etten, and Julien Baker. But went Carpenter graduated, he departed for Anchorage, Alaska, to pursue his music career. The perhaps unorthodox move worked well for Carpenter, however; known artistically as Medium Build, he is signed to Island Records and is set to release a new album, King of Having Fun, on September 4.
